recommendation: Keep the additive fix. If the work group later wants only one abandoned-state code, treat that as a separate terminology decision because removing or renaming the published `not-done` code would be breaking.
issue_request: FHIR-36263 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core Consent in R5 and requested adding the Resource Status `abandoned` code to the Consent.status value set for consent requests that expire without ever being accepted or declined.
initial_application: The issue had historical application commits: 27635dd16f added an abandoned-state Consent status concept, e757a816b1 corrected that concept to `not-done` and updated the Consent.status short/status-codes sources, and 91ff45e541 later normalized the source. The current source and R5 publication therefore included the abandoned state as `not-done` with display `Abandoned`, but did not include the literal requested `abandoned` code.
additional_context: Consent is active in source/fhir.ini, and ValueSet/consent-state-codes includes the whole Consent state CodeSystem. The published `not-done` code was retained to avoid a breaking rename; searches found no later Jira, Zulip, or Confluence decision reversing FHIR-36263.
reconciliation: Added `abandoned` to source/consent/codesystem-consent-state-codes.xml, updated the Consent.status short description, status search parameter description, Event mapping exception, and status-codes matrix so the current build surfaces the requested code consistently.
source_changes: source/consent/codesystem-consent-state-codes.xml: added the `abandoned` concept to the Consent state CodeSystem that feeds ValueSet/consent-state-codes.
source/consent/structuredefinition-Consent.xml: added `abandoned` to the Consent.status short code list.
source/consent/bundle-Consent-search-params.xml: aligned the Consent-status SearchParameter description with the current status code list.
source/consent/consent-event-mapping-exceptions.xml: aligned the Consent/Event status mapping exception with the current Consent.status code list.
source/status-codes.xml: mapped Consent.status `abandoned` into the common Resource Status abandoned column.
